dct_description_sm: Abstract: This layer consists of points representing Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) Program Facilities for the state of Massachusetts, 2024. This dataset was derived and processed from the 2024 TRI Preliminary Dataset: Basic Plus Data Files. Retrieved on September 8, 2025 from https://www.epa.gov/toxics-release-inventory-tri-program/2024-tri-preliminary-dataset-basic-plus-data-files. The derived version of the source dataset was optimitized for teaching purposes and contains only a limited representation of the full set of data attributes found in the source dataset. Please refer to the source data set to access the full set of data attributes. TRI tracks the waste management of certain toxic chemicals that may pose a threat to human health and the environment. U.S. facilities in certain industry sectors must report annually how much of each chemical they release into the environment and/or manage through recycling, energy recovery and treatment, as well as any practices implemented to prevent or reduce the generation of chemical waste.
Purpose: This dataset was derived and processed for use as part of a Harvard Library GIS training module.
